description: Extremes Tool - Record-setting conditions is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Southern Regional Climate Center (SRCC); Applied Climate Information System. View extreme temperature and precipitation records for airport stations throughout the United States. Find records for specific calendar dates, records over a month, recent daily records, and all-time records for four temperature elements and high precipitation. Once you make selections, locations where records were set are marked on the map. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Flooding – Rainfall-induced. Assets: Critical Facilities, Energy and Utilities, People, Property, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
